style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Early 1900s period details. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty white space with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos or emblems of real companies or government agencies, readable text or numbers, banknote designs, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people
